subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Portia’s father wanted a man to marry her for love, not for (a) -------. So he set a test using three caskets— one gold, one silver, and one lead. The suitor who chose the casket with Portia’s (b) ------- inside would win her hand in marriage. The prince of Morocco chose the gold casket, thinking the most valuable metal must hold something (c) -------. But he found only a skull and a message: “All that glitters is not gold.” The prince of Spain picked the silver casket, believing he (d) ------- the best. Inside was the picture of a blinking fool. Finally, Bassanio came and wisely chose the plain-looking lead casket, believing that appearances can be (e) -------. He opened it and found Portia’s portrait. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) wealth; (b) portrait; (c) precious; (d) deserved; (e) deceptive. ● st ●
